missions.full:
Ready for Speed Demon?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Stand two big kid steps apart.

Toss quickly, but keep each toss gentle.

Catch on the blue side. Take the ball off with your free hand, then toss it back.

How many catches can you make in forty-five seconds? Try to beat your own best.

Keep tosses below chin level. Never aim at anyone’s face.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Keep tosses quick but gentle, below chin level. Catch on the blue side, take the ball off with your free hand, and toss it back.

missions.full:
Ready for Red Light, Green Light?

You'll need two to three players, one paddle for each player, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Choose one of you to call Green or Red. With three players, the third person can call. With two players, take turns calling.

Green means toss and catch. Red means freeze. No tossing or moving on Red.

You make the calls and keep track of the sixty seconds. This recording explains the game; the phone does not call colors or time your round.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Play for sixty seconds without tossing on Red.

When you hear Red, stop and stay still.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: One of you calls the colors. Toss and catch on Green. Freeze on Red. The phone is not the caller.

missions.full:
Ready for Quick Slap?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Keep the paddle strapped to one hand while your partner makes a gentle toss.

Use your free hand to lightly tap your own paddle once.

Catch the ball on the blue side. Switch roles after every ten throws.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make ten clean tap-and-catches each.

Tap gently with your free hand. Keep your paddle strapped on; it has no handle.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Keep your paddle strapped on. Tap your own paddle once, lightly, with your free hand, then catch on the blue side.

missions.full:
Ready for Switcharoo?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Catch the ball on the blue side with the hand wearing the paddle.

Use your free hand to take the ball off.

Pass the ball to the hand that is still wearing the paddle.

Carefully slide that hand out of the strap.

Put the paddle on your other hand and secure the strap.

The hand holding the ball is now free. Use it to make a gentle toss.

Make your next catch with the other paddle hand. Repeat this whole hand switch after every clean catch.

Be the first to make twelve catches, switching paddle hands after each one.

Take your time switching hands. Never toss the paddle between hands or change hands with the ball still stuck to it. There is no handle.
missions.active: After a clean catch, take the ball off first. Pass it to your paddle hand before removing that hand from the strap. Switch the paddle safely to your other hand.

missions.full:
Ready for Statue Mode?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Catch on the blue side, then freeze like a statue for two seconds.

Keep your paddle, body, and feet still.

When the freeze is over, take the ball off with your free hand and gently toss it back.

Make ten catches, with a full freeze after each one.

Stay completely still during each two-second freeze.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Catch on the blue side and freeze for two seconds. Then take the ball off with your free hand and toss it back.

missions.full:
Ready for Number Echo?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Toss the ball and call out the number.

The catcher repeats the number, takes the ball off, and tosses it back.

If the ball drops, start counting again from one.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Count out loud together and reach fifteen catches in a row.

A missed catch is okay. Take a breath and start again.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Call the number as you toss. The catcher echoes it. If the ball drops, start again from one.

missions.full:
Ready for Rainbow Throws?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Stand five big steps apart.

Make gentle rainbow-shaped tosses toward your partner’s paddle, never their head.

Flat tosses do not count. After five clean rainbow tosses, step back.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Complete three distance levels, with five rainbow tosses at each level.

Use a gentle arc, not a hard throw. Let the ball come down naturally.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Make gentle rainbow tosses toward the paddle. After five clean rainbow tosses, step back. Flat tosses do not count.

missions.full:
Ready for The Landing Pad?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Make a gentle toss in a high arc.

The catcher holds the paddle flat and still, with the blue side facing up, like a landing pad.

Let the ball come down, land, and stick on the blue side. Do not swing at it.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make eight clean landings on the paddle.

Let the ball stick. Do not swat or hit it.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Hold the paddle flat and still, blue side up. Let the ball land and stick. Do not swing at it.

missions.full:
Ready for Step-Back Challenge?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Start one big step apart and make three clean catches.

Step back half a step, then make another three clean catches.

Keep going until you are three big steps apart.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Reach three big steps apart and make three clean catches there.

Stop if you can no longer keep your tosses controlled.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Make three clean catches before each half-step back. Stop if your tosses become hard to control.

missions.full:
Ready for Power Step?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Start six big kid steps apart.

Step forward as you make a gentle toss.

After the catch, step back to your starting spot. Now it’s your partner’s turn.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make ten clean step-and-toss turns each.

Keep the toss gentle. The step already adds power.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Step forward with your gentle toss. After the catch, step back to your starting spot. Then it is your partner’s turn.

missions.full:
Ready for Sky Floater?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Make a gentle, controlled high toss toward the paddle.

The catcher waits calmly for the ball to come down.

Catch it as it drops onto the blue side of the paddle.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make ten patient catches from high tosses.

Take your time. Do not swing the paddle at the ball.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Make a gentle, controlled high toss. Wait for the ball to come down onto the blue side. Do not swing.

missions.full:
Ready for Heart-High?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Stand six big steps apart.

The catcher holds the paddle at chest height, with its blue side facing the ball.

Toss toward the blue paddle face, never the person’s chest. A toss that is too high or too low does not count.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make ten catches in a row on the paddle at chest height.

Aim at the blue paddle face, never anyone’s body.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Hold the paddle at chest height. Aim at the blue paddle face, never the person’s chest.

missions.full:
Ready for Silent Mode?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

While you play, no talking.

After each catch, show the count with your fingers. If anyone speaks, start counting again from one.

You can listen before starting or when you ask for Help. When you return to the game, the narration stays quiet.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make twelve catches without talking.

Take a breath before each toss.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!

Ready for Tempo Master?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Make five very slow throws.

Then make five throws at a medium pace.

Repeat those two sets once more. Keep your feet in place.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Finish all twenty throws without dropping the ball.

Keep your feet planted. Only your arms move.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Five slow throws, then five at a medium pace. Repeat once. Keep your feet in place.

missions.full:
Ready for Spotlight Eyes?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Before a catch, the catcher calls, “I see it!”

Wait until you hear the call, then toss.

Catch, say “I see it!” again, and toss the ball back.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make fifteen catches with the “I see it!” call.

Stay the same distance apart. No surprise tosses.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: The catcher calls, I see it! Wait for the call before tossing. No surprise tosses.

missions.full:
Ready for One, Two, Three, Go!?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

The thrower counts “one, two, three” out loud.

Release the ball right on “three.”

The catcher counts “one, two, three” before tossing it back.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make ten catches with tosses timed to the count.

Count calmly and keep a steady rhythm.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Count one, two, three, and release right on three. Keep a calm, steady rhythm.

missions.full:
Ready for Mirror Mode?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Choose a leader. The leader shows a comfortable paddle pose: high, low, or gently tilted.

The catcher copies that pose on their own body. You do not need the same angle in the room.

The leader makes a gentle toss with their free hand. The catcher holds the matching pose and catches on the blue side.

The catcher takes the ball off with their free hand and gently tosses it back to the leader.

The same leader makes five challenge tosses, then you switch roles. Those return passes do not count toward the five.

Complete eight mirror-and-catch rounds.

Use comfortable poses. Do not stretch too far or tilt sharply. Catch on the blue side.
missions.active: Copy the comfortable paddle pose on your own body. Catch on the blue side. The same leader makes five challenge tosses; return passes do not count.

missions.full:
Ready for Count to ten?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Count every clean catch out loud together.

If the ball drops, start again from one.

No pressure. Have another go together.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make ten catches without dropping the ball.

Starting over is part of the game. Keep it relaxed.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Count clean catches together. If the ball drops, start again from one. No pressure.

missions.full:
Ready for Round Robin?

You'll need three to four players, one paddle for each player, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Stand in a circle, each wearing a paddle.

Toss to anyone, but never to the same person twice in a row.

Keep every toss gentle.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Play for two full minutes. Count the drops and try to beat your own record.

Leave space between players. Do not crowd together.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Stay in your circle and toss gently. Do not toss to the same person twice in a row.

missions.full:
Ready for Crab Shuffle Relay?

You'll need four players, four paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Four players make two lines. Share just one ball.

Catch on the blue side. Take the ball off with your free hand, then toss it gently to the next player.

After passing, stay on your feet and shuffle sideways to the back of your own line.

Make twenty passes together across both lines.

Stay on your feet and move sideways. No running or crab-walking on your hands. Never put your weight on a hand wearing a paddle.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Catch, take the ball off, then toss to the next player. After your pass, shuffle sideways to the back of your line. Stay on your feet.

missions.full:
Ready for Middle Defender?

You'll need three players, three paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Play with three people, three paddles, and one ball. Two players face each other, with the third in the middle.

The outside players toss to each other below face level.

If the middle player catches the ball on the paddle, they walk over and trade places with the person who threw it.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make six catches in the middle. Everyone gets a turn.

Keep tosses below face level. Walk when trading places. Do not dive for the ball.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Outside players toss below face level. If the middle player catches on the blue side, walk and trade places with the thrower.

missions.full:
Ready for Spin Squad?

You'll need four players, four paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Four players stand in a square, each wearing a paddle.

One player tosses to anyone.

After each catch, everyone steps clockwise. Then make the next toss.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make twenty catches, with everyone moving after each catch.

Move calmly and leave room for each other.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: After each catch, everyone steps clockwise. Make the next toss after the move. Leave room for each other.

missions.full:
Ready for Mix It Up?

You'll need four players, four paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Four players share one ball. One pair plays while the others wait.

That pair makes six clean catches, then gives the ball to the next pair.

Play each pairing once. With four players, there are six different pairs.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Finish all six pairings, with six clean catches per pair.

Change partners calmly. Use only one ball, with only one pair playing at a time.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: One pair plays with one ball. After six clean catches, give the ball to the next pair.

missions.full:
Ready for Two-on-Two Squad Count?

You'll need four players, four paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Make two teams of two. Share one ball and take turns playing.

One team makes five clean catches, then gives the ball to the other team.

Add both teams' catches to one shared total. Only one team plays at a time.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Reach forty catches together.

Only one team plays at a time. You can use four paddles, but never run two games at once.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: One team plays at a time. Five clean catches, then the other team takes the ball. Add catches toward your shared forty.

missions.full:
Ready for Chill Catch?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Stay seated on the floor or a chair. Make a short, gentle toss with your free hand.

Catch on the blue side. Take the ball off with your free hand, then gently toss it back.

Make fifteen clean catches while seated.

Keep tosses gentle and below face level. Stay about three to ten feet, or one to three meters apart with a grown-up supervising. Clear away breakable things.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Stay seated. Make short, gentle tosses below face level. Catch on the blue side, take the ball off with your free hand, and toss it back.

missions.full:
Ready for Tiny Space?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Stand just one big step apart.

Toss gently without stepping forward.

Keep your feet in place the whole time.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make twelve clean catches in your small space.

Watch for lamps, shelves, and other nearby objects.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Stay one big step apart. Keep your feet in place and toss gently without stepping forward.

missions.full:
Ready for Secret Signal?

You'll need two to three players, one paddle for each player, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Before you start, choose a simple paddle signal. You could briefly raise your paddle or gently tilt it to the side.

With two players, pass back and forth. With three, pass around the circle from the first player to the second, then the third, then back to the first. Use just one ball.

Catch on the blue side. Take the ball off with your free hand, and keep it in that hand.

With your paddle hand, show your signal to the next catcher.

Wait until they see it. Then make a gentle toss with your free hand. No signal means no toss.

Make ten catches with your secret signal.

Choose a simple paddle signal that is easy to see. You do not need finger gestures. Use only one ball.
missions.active: Take the ball off and hold it in your free hand. Show your paddle signal to the next catcher. No signal means no toss.

missions.full:
Ready for Mind Reader?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

The thrower secretly chooses left, right, or center.

Wait three seconds without giving any hints.

Before the toss, the catcher guesses and moves the paddle into position.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Guess correctly eight times out of twelve.

Keep tosses gentle and stay a predictable distance apart. Only the direction is a surprise.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Choose left, right, or center secretly. Wait three seconds. The catcher guesses and moves the paddle before the toss.

missions.full:
Ready for Stuck-Foot Catch?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Both players keep their feet in place.

Make gentle tosses.

Catch and toss back without chasing the ball.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make twenty clean catches.

If tosses get hard to control, slow down together.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Keep your feet in place. Make gentle tosses without chasing the ball. Slow down if you need to.

missions.full:
Ready for Left or Right!?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Choose who calls and tosses first. Left and right always mean the catcher's own left and right.

Before each challenge toss, the caller says Left or Right.

The catcher moves the paddle to that side of their own body, keeping the blue side facing the incoming ball.

The caller makes a straight, gentle toss toward that paddle. Never aim at the person's body.

A correct catch means the ball sticks to the blue side on the called side.

The catcher takes the ball off with their free hand and gently tosses it back. This return needs no call, and it does not count.

The same caller makes five challenge tosses, then you switch roles. Return passes do not count toward those five.

Make eight correct catches on the called side.

Aim at the blue paddle face on the called side, never at the person. Keep tosses straight and gentle.
missions.active: Call before the challenge toss. Aim at the blue paddle face on the catcher’s own called side. Returns need no call and do not count. Switch after five challenge tosses.

missions.full:
Ready for Cloud Chaser?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Stand six big steps apart.

Make a controlled high toss. Never aim at anyone’s face or head.

Watch the ball come down and catch it on the blue side.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make ten catches from high tosses.

The ball travels in a high arc, but the target is always the paddle.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Make controlled high tosses toward the paddle, never anyone’s head. Catch on the blue side as the ball comes down.

missions.full:
Ready for Home Base?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Each player picks a home base, such as a shadow, sidewalk square, or patch of grass.

Toss and catch from your base. Keep your feet in place.

Stepping off your base counts as a miss.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make ten catches while staying on your base.

Choose safe, flat ground for each base.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Stay on your home base. Keep your feet in place. Stepping off your base counts as a miss.

missions.full:
Ready for How Far Can You Throw??

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Start six big kid steps apart.

Make three clean catches, then both step back two big steps.

Keep going and remember your best distance.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Try to beat your own distance record.

As you move farther apart, use controlled arcs toward the paddle. Do not throw harder at a person.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Three clean catches, then both step back two big steps. Use controlled arcs toward the paddle, not harder throws at a person.

missions.full:
Ready for Chase the Ball!?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

The thrower tosses a little ahead of the catcher, not too far.

The catcher runs to meet the ball.

Catch it on the paddle before it reaches the ground.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Make seven running catches.

Choose a clear running area with no obstacles.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Toss just a little ahead. Run to meet the ball and catch on the blue side before it reaches the ground. Keep the path clear.

missions.full:
Ready for Sky High Jump?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Toss just above the catcher's normal paddle reach, never at their head. Do not toss too high.

The catcher waits for the toss, then jumps and catches on the blue side while in the air.

Land on both feet before taking the ball off with your free hand. Switch roles every five throws.

Make eight jumping catches.

Use flat, soft ground. Grass is best. Land on both feet before taking the ball off.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: Wait for the toss, then jump and catch on the blue side. Land on both feet before taking the ball off.

missions.full:
Ready for Marathon Rally?

You'll need two players, two paddles, and one ball. Keep your paddle on with the hand strap on the back.

Start close together and toss back and forth.

After every five clean catches, both step back one big step.

See how far apart you can get while keeping the rally going.

Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of your paddle. Take the ball off with your free hand, then make your next gentle toss with that hand.

Reach twenty catches without dropping the ball.

Stop stepping back if you cannot keep the tosses controlled.

Take your time and enjoy playing together!
missions.active: After five clean catches, both step back one big step. Stop stepping back if your tosses get hard to control.
